description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to Helm chart arguments and configurations within the Kubernetes kustomize project. It includes structures for Helm global settings, chart specifics, and argument handling, along with functions to split parameters and generate Helm CLI arguments.

classes.name: HelmGlobals
classes.description: Holds global Helm configuration options such as ChartHome and ConfigHome.

classes.name: HelmChart
classes.description: Represents a Helm chart with its metadata and deployment options.

classes.name: HelmChartArgs
classes.description: Deprecated structure for Helm arguments, replaced by HelmGlobals and HelmChart.

methods.name: SplitHelmParameters
methods.description: Splits a list of HelmChartArgs into individual HelmCharts and global settings.

methods.name: makeHelmChartFromHca
methods.description: Creates a HelmChart object from HelmChartArgs.

methods.name: HelmChart.AsHelmArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for Helm based on HelmChart properties.
